tools.name: describe_corpus
tools.description: Discover exact Dataset coverage, time basis, schema and supported capabilities; use before selecting filters. Returns Dataset metadata and quality/ownership coverage.

tools.name: search_logs
tools.description: Retrieve bounded full-text Log Entries with declared all/any/phrase/fuzzy semantics. Use for discovery and examples; use count_by/trend for frequency. Returns stable keys, snippets, exact total and continuation.

tools.name: get_context
tools.description: Read bounded before/after Log Entries for an existing anchor on the same node/request/instance. Reject absent correlation ids; never broaden them to the whole Dataset.

tools.name: count_by
tools.description: Calculate exact matching Log Entry counts by allowlisted dimensions over the full declared Data Scope. Groups, total groups and source-entry totals are distinct.

tools.name: trend
tools.description: Calculate counts in fixed time buckets over the declared Data Scope. Disclose incomplete coverage and return every bucket or an explicit continuation; samples are not trends.

tools.name: top_patterns
tools.description: Rank versioned message templates by matching Log Entry count, with Component identity and unmatched/ambiguous/empty diagnostics. Never treat template counts as Incident counts.

tools.name: latency_stats
tools.description: Calculate timed-operation count and p50/p95/p99/max seconds for HTTP requests OR instance builds. Never mix these durations. Include threshold counts and missing-duration coverage.

tools.name: compare_periods
tools.description: Compare the same metrics/filters in two explicit time intervals. Return both counts, elapsed denominators and rates; zero baseline percentage change is null with a reason.

tools.name: group_entries
tools.description: Derive policy-defined temporal groups with threshold sensitivity and spread. These are candidate groups, not verified Incidents; retain policy and boundary-censor flags.

tools.name: get_evidence
tools.description: Retrieve immutable original Evidence and its SQL/parameters/results for this investigation. Does not silently rerun SQL; a deliberate replay creates new Evidence linked to the original.
